per_step.trigger_denominator_definition: all steps; per-step Guided Search scales every step

mur.trigger_denominator_definition: sum(max(steps-1,0)); MUR never scales the first step

decision.note: A fixed 100-question exploratory result does not establish a complete MATH-500 reproduction.
decision.scope: computed on the 50 complete paired questions from chunks 0-1; the fixed100 task is incomplete and this is exploratory only

verifier.cost_role: separate from policy+critic generation token metric

audit.note: Labels were assigned by a seeded random permutation per question. The mapping file is separate; no verifier label was changed.

limitations: Only 50 of the frozen 100 questions are complete; chunks 2-3 are not used.
Chunk 2 was stopped by the frozen combined phase cap after 36/75 trajectories; its 46 trajectories were never graded and are not in the 50-question metrics.
API-returned tokens are a compute proxy, not exact GPU FLOPs.
Latency on a shared GPU is descriptive, not a controlled speedup.
One seed only; no outcome-based stopping, tuning or question replacement.
The 50-question subset is the first two frozen chunks in manifest order, not an outcome-selected subset; 50-question intervals do not establish non-inferiority.
